references.text: Context for the curse: Ham, Canaan's father, saw his father's nakedness and told his brothers.
Continuation of Noah's prophetic words: the blessing of Shem and Japheth, and that Canaan shall be their servant.
Lists the descendants of Canaan, who were struck by the curse in Gen 9:25.
God's command to Israel to drive out and destroy the Canaanite nations - a fulfillment of the curse over Canaan.
The Gibeonites (Canaanites) were made woodcutters and water carriers - a direct fulfillment of the curse 'servant of servants'.
Solomon imposed forced labor on the remaining Canaanites in the land - a fulfillment of Noah's curse over Canaan.
The Canaanites were put to forced labor under Israel, but not completely driven out - partial fulfillment of the curse.
